4776.before:
Applicants should have completed a qualifying degree (e.g. Bachelor's degree) from a European or foreign college or university in the fields of (Molecular) Biomedicine, Biochemistry, Medical Biology, Biology, Human Biology or in a related life sciences field. The degree must have been completed with the German grade 2.3 /good (In the German grading system, 1.0 [very good] is the best, 2.0 [good] and 4.0 is considered sufficient to pass.) Applicants who have not yet completed their Bachelor's degrees must prove a current grade of 2.0 (German system).
Prerequisite courses include:
- 30 ECTS (European Credit Transfer and Accumulation System credit points) in total in Immunology, Pharmacology, Biochemistry, Anatomy or Physiology
- 30 ECTS in total in subjects like Chemistry, Genetics, Developmental Biology, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology or Microbiology
In addition, the final thesis written as part of the first higher education degree must be a text based on a practical wet lab experiment; students in a degree programme whose curriculum does not include a thesis are required to provide proof of practical experience working in a research laboratory worth at least 15 ECTS.
A transcript of records with achieved grades has to be included in the application.
More details about our entry requirements and the selection procedure can be found on our website.

5664.before:
For admission to the Master’s programme IMIS Online, the applicant is required to prove the successful completion of a Bachelor’s programme, their professional expertise and their language skills.
Successful completion of a Bachelor’s programme
• of at least seven semesters with a volume of 210 credits or a diploma degree course in Economics (Business) or Business Informatics or a comparable degree course with an overall grade at least equal to the German grade "good" (2.5) or the relative ECTS grade A or B, OR
• of six semesters with a volume of 180 credits in Economics (Business) or Business Informatics or a comparable degree course with an overall grade at least equal to the German grade "good" (2.5) or the relative ECTS grade A or B, and
• an additional qualification requirement defined by the examination board of the Master's programme, OR
• proof of relevant qualified practical professional experience from a subject-specific project for at least six months in addition to 12 months of practical professional experience
Professional expertise
Proof of relevant, qualified practical experience of at least 12 months after completing a course of study qualifying for a profession

9921.before:
The Mobile Robotics study programme addresses highly motivated students with an excellent Bachelor’s degree in computer science, geodesy, or related subjects such as electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or similar. Students are expected to have a background in mathematics, programming (e.g. Python), and basic engineering skills.
In detail applicants must fulfil the following requirements according to § 5 of the Examination Regulations of the Master's Programme Mobile Robotics.
The university degree must have been completed with a grade of at least 2.5 (minimum grade is subject to change). The grade is calculated using the modified Bavarian formula during the application process.
In detail, students must submit proof of the following:
• a total of at least 18 credits from mathematics
• a total of at least 6 credits from programming
• Additional achievements from at least one of the subject areas
• mathematics
• programming
• engineering sciences
• physics
• computer science or
• geodesy
Students must achieve in total at least 26 credits from the areas 3.1 - 3.6.
• An academic thesis worth at least 10 credits .
Before you apply, please check the requirements carefully.
9921.after:
The programme addresses highly motivated students with an excellent Bachelor’s degree in computer science, geodesy, or related subjects such as electrical engineering, applied mathematics, or similar. Students are expected to have a background in mathematics, programming (e.g. Python), and basic engineering skills.
We expect a minimum average BSc grade of 2.0 (German University grading system). The grade is calculated using the modified Bavarian formula during the application process.
In detail, students must submit proof of the following:
• a total of at least 24 credits from mathematics
• a total of at least 6 credits from programming
• Additional achievements from at least one of the subject areas
• mathematics
• programming
• engineering sciences
• physics
• computer science or
• geodesy
Students must achieve in total at least 26 credits from the areas 3.1 - 3.6.
• An academic thesis worth at least 10 credits .
Before you apply, please check the requirements carefully.
GRE Test
Students with a European Bachelor's degree are not required to submit a GRE test. All other students are requested to submit a GRE test. Minimum recommended GRE test scores are:
• Quantitative Reasoning: 160 points
• Verbal Reasoning: 145 points
• Analytical Writing: 3 points
Further Requirements
Students with BSc degrees from non-European countries that administer nationwide university entrance exams (such as the JEE in India or the Gaokao in China) are asked to submit their results as part of their application. In particular, this means:
• India : Students must submit their Joint Entrance Examination Advanced (JEE Advanced) results, including the All India Rank (AIR), with their application.
• China : Students must submit their Gaokao results with their application.
• Pakistan : Students are asked to submit their ECAT (Engineering College Admission Test) or their university-specific entry test results.
